question.text: The CML can be extended to the RIGHT of the Market Portfolio by:

answer.text: Borrowing at risk-free rate and investing in market portfolio

explanation.text: The Logic: Leverage: borrow at Rf, invest > 100% of wealth in Market portfolio → leveraged position to the right of M on CML. Higher return, higher risk. The Trap: Short-selling creates negative exposures, not leverage. Cross-Exam Context: CML extension. Manager's Pro-Tip: Leverage amplifies both gains and losses — monitor margin and volatility carefully.
